newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania Swedish truck sales up 79 pct '96.
newsitem.headline: Scania Swedish truck sales up 79 pct '96.

text.p: Swedish truck maker Scania's domestic car sales rose 79 percent to 2,142 trucks in 1996, from 1,200 in 1995, the company said on Thursday.
Meanwhile, total Swedish truck registrations surged 60 percent to 4,438 heavy trucks in 1996.
Scania increased its domestic market share to 48.3 percent in 1996, up from 43.6 percent the previous year, a company spokesman said.
Scania also boosted its European market share to 15.4 percent in the first three quarters of 1996, from 14.4 percent in the corresponding period a year earlier, the company said.

"The success derives from our strong product program, which during 1996 was strengthened by the 4-series, the new generation of Scania trucks," said Christer Skogsborg, president of Scania Sweden, in a statement.
